ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on good Behaviour? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on good Behaviour has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on good Behaviour with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on good Behaviour.
   D. Use Hadith on good Behaviour to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
